name: CreateAgentStorage

parameters.help_en: The description of the agent storage. The description must be 3 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 智能体存储描述。长度限制在 3-256 个字符之间
parameters.name: agent_storage_description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the agent storage. The naming conventions are as follows:
The name can contain only letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
The name must start with a letter.
The name cannot end with a hyphen (-).
The name is case-insensitive.
The name must be 3 to 16 characters in length.
The name cannot contain the following words: ali, ay, ots, taobao, or admin
parameters.help_zh:
智能体存储名称。智能体存储的命名规范如下：
必须由英文字母、数字或短划线（-）组成。
首字符必须为英文字母。
末尾字符不能为短划线（-）。
大小写不敏感。
长度在3~16字符之间。
智能体存储名称不能包含ali、ay、ots、taobao、admin这几个单词
parameters.name: agent_storage_name

parameters.help_en: (Deprecated) The network type of the agent storage. Valid values: NORMAL and VPC_CONSOLE. Default value: NORMAL
parameters.help_zh: （已弃用）智能体存储网络类型。NORMAL, VPC_CONSOLE。默认为NORMAL
parameters.name: network

parameters.help_en:
The list of allowed network sources for the agent storage. All sources are allowed by default. Valid values:
TRUST_PROXY: console
parameters.help_zh: 智能体存储允许的网络来源列表。默认都允许。TRUST_PROXY: 控制台
parameters.name: network_source_acl

parameters.help_en:
The list of allowed network types for the agent storage. All types are allowed by default. Valid values:
CLASSIC: classic network.
INTERNET: public network.
VPC: VPC network
parameters.help_zh: 智能体存储允许的网络类型列表。默认都允许。CLASSIC: 经典网；INTERNET: 公网；VPC：VPC网络
parameters.name: network_type_acl

parameters.help_en: The access control policy for the agent storage in JSON format. For the syntax, see https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ram/user-guide/policy-structure-and-syntax
parameters.help_zh: 智能体存储访问控制策略，JSON格式。配置语法见：https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ram/user-guide/policy-structure-and-syntax
parameters.name: policy
